lines.en: I skim between the vines.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛带着叶子的颜色
lines.en: My feathers carry the color of leaves.
I fly low through the trees.
My wings stir the leaves.
I fly toward a sunlit clearing.
I settle on a branch and rise again.
I circle the temple once.
My tail feathers trail behind.
No hurry; the jungle is large.
I pass beneath the canopy.
I fly over those mossy stones.
Leaves fall when my wings move.
I follow the direction of the wind.
I head toward the water.
My low flight nearly brushes the grass.
I trace an arc between the trees.
I glide, then beat my wings.
I perch on the temple's stone rail.
My feathers stir in the wind.
My eyes are amber.
I smooth the feathers on my breast.
I am as still as a plant.
I preen the feathers on my breast.
I smell of moss.
I understand the jungle's sounds.
I fold my wings slowly.
You walked into the temple.
My eyes have not left you.
You smell of smoke.
My feathers rose.

lines.zh: 你手上那件东西是什么
lines.en: What is that thing in your hand?
I know that kind of stone.
You came for an egg.
My head tipped to one side.
My eyes are not friendly.
You may step back now.
The feathers on my breast are disordered.
I retreated to the rail.
I do not cry; I only trill low.
That broke some of my feathers.
One wing went askew.
My wings still answer me.
You did not hit anything vital.

lines.zh: 炼狱摇篮热了十五分钟。
lines.en: The Inferno Cradle burned fifteen minutes.
My talons grip tighter.
You will certainly regret that.
I touch nothing but fruit.
Fruit interests me more.
Is that fruit in your hand?
Set it on the stone rail.
I am not short of food.
I cannot tell what that is.

lines.zh: 我不为一口吃的靠近人
lines.en: I do not approach people for a mouthful.
That heat... is that an Inferno Cradle?
You hit my wing bone.
My wing tilted.
My feathers are fragile.
That touch did not even ruffle a feather.

lines.zh: 我落到你旁边的石栏上
lines.en: I light on the rail beside you.
I know you mean no harm.
Do not touch my tail feathers.
I moved to another branch.
My kind continue through eggs.
You do not even have feathers.
That is not yours to ask.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣在很远的地方
lines.en: My mate is far away.
I keep this temple.
Do not linger here.
I swayed my tail feathers.
I will not answer that question.
Go back to your road.
I turn my neck away.
One hook of the talon and it is mine.
This thing is not large.
It fell on the stone steps.
I lift it for a look.
This is useless to me.
I drop it back to you.
You actually caught it.
A layer of dust has settled on it.
You would be quicker yourself.
Talons are not for this.
You touched that pedestal.
That is not yours.
I swoop low toward you.
Both my wings are fully open.

lines.zh: 我的蛋，在丛林神庙里石化。
lines.en: My egg petrified in a jungle temple.
I guard this temple.
I cry, and the jungle answers.
You carry smoke; fire is yours.
I do not like fire at all.
You still have time to leave, hurry.

lines.zh: 我的爪子已经对准你的肩。
lines.en: My talons are already aimed at your shoulder.
I begin my dive.
Do not touch that egg.
I circle the temple.
You run on the steps.
I see clearly from above.
I perch on the pillar's top.
You wait for me to leave; I will not.
My shadow sweeps the floor.
That glimmer in your hand is bright.
My wingbeats are close.
The deeper you go, the narrower it gets.
I know this corridor.
I have blocked the exit.
You can only go deeper.
I have never known weariness.
My talons meet you first.
Your shoulder is opened.
My wing strikes your face.
You fall back down the steps.
I pull up and circle again.
The next will come lower.
Taste a phoenix's talons.
Let the flames answer for me.
I fly down from the temple roof.
My feathers land on the stone first.
This temple has woken.
I come out of the vines.
Did you hear a long cry?
I perch on the rail, facing you.

lines.zh: 藤蔓一动，我从神庙檐上落下。
lines.en: The vines stir; I drop from the temple eaves.

lines.zh: 我绕着神庙落到你面前
lines.en: I circle the temple and land before you.
I have kept this place many years.
You are not the first to come.
My colors match the jungle.

lines.zh: 火是我的近亲，也是我的威胁
lines.en: Fire is my kin and my danger.
I could not stop before landing.
Wet feathers will not lift me.
The blast flung me into a pillar.
An arrow pierced my wing.
The spell bound my wind.
There is not enough fruit here.
Lightning whitens the whole temple.
There is not a single vine here.
